name: traxide
description: A fast autorouter: routes the open board in seconds. Needs the KiCad API enabled.
description_full:
Adds a Route board button to the PCB editor's toolbar, which routes every unrouted connection of the open board with traxide and adds the routes as one step that Edit → Undo takes back. Copper zones are refilled around the routes afterwards, as a step of its own. A second button, Route selected nets, routes only the nets of what is selected; a third, Optimise, pulls the board's own unlocked tracks tight, shorter and with fewer corners, as one step too.

The button needs KiCad's API, which is off by default: without it KiCad shows no traxide button at all. Tick Preferences → Preferences… → Plugins → Enable KiCad API, then restart the PCB editor.

traxide is a fast, dependency-free autorouter written in Rust, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. The package carries the traxide binary for its platform, which also routes from the command line.
